name: Glowing Fruit
summary: On Teldrassil, a strange fruit glows beneath unusual fronds. Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth studies its strange reaction to the World Tree's soil.

sections.title: A Curious Specimen
sections.body: The Glowing Fruit hangs beneath unusual fronds on Teldrassil, bright and round. Botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth recognizes it as foreign to the World Tree. He thinks its seeds came from distant lands across the sea. Its reaction to Teldrassil's rich, enchanted soil shows how foreign plants can affect the young World Tree.

faq.answer: The Glowing Fruit is a round fruit found beneath unusual fronds on Teldrassil. It shines with its own light and reacts strangely to the local soil.

faq.q: Where did this fruit come from?
aliases: where did the seeds come from
faq.answer: Denalan believes the Glowing Fruit is foreign to Teldrassil. He suspects its seeds came from far across the sea, perhaps from the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Who wants to inspect the Glowing Fruit?
aliases: where do i bring glowing fruit
faq.answer: Denalan, a night elf researcher at Lake Al'Ameth, wants to study the Glowing Fruit. He studies Teldrassil's boughs and ecosystem, and takes an interest in foreign plants that react with the World Tree's soil.

angles.text: As a druid attuned to Teldrassil's balance, you may see foreign plants that react strangely with its soil as a threat to the young World Tree.
As an herbalist, you can see the fruit's strange glow as a sign of an unusual interaction between foreign seeds and enchanted soil.
